svg.title: MIPS Embedded System Development Roadmap
svg.desc: Nine phases from reading documentation to production hardening, laid out along a winding road.
svg.text: From datasheet to production: each phase builds on a proven milestone from the one before.

g.text: ISA version: MIPS32 r2 vs r6, endianness
Core manual: CP0, caches, TLB, hazards
SoC manual: memory map, IRQ ctrl, clocks
CP0 Status, watchdog off, SRAM stack
C runs from DDR and prints
Read Config1/2: line size, sets, ways
wback / inv / sync ranges for DMA
sync barriers; TLB refill if MMU used
Context layout: GPRs, hi/lo, EPC, Status
ROM → SPL → U-Boot, OTA / A-B images

svg.text: = milestone that gates the next phase
